name: TeamStarWolf - Insider Threat
description: Curated practitioner view of Insider Threat behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Malicious or negligent insider behaviors: abuse of legitimate access to collect, stage, and exfiltrate data or sabotage. Cross-tactic selection; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting). Every ID/tactic validated against the bundled ATT&CK v16 data.
